questions.passage: Born in 1888 in Bombay (now Mumbai), India, Sarojini Naidu was a talented poet and political leader. She received the nickname "The Nightingale of India" because of the beauty of her poetry. She began writing poetry at age 12 and was soon recognized for her literary talent. In 1905, her first collection of poems was __________. Later she joined India's struggle for freedom from British rule. As a powerful speaker, she traveled widely and influenced many people. She became the first woman to serve as the president of the Indian National Congress in 1925. After India's independence, she served as the governor of the Uttar Pradesh province until her death in 1949.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: published=출판된 (1905년에 첫 시 모음집이 출판되었다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① recognized: recognized(인정받은)은 인정 맥락이지 시집 발행이 아님
✅ ② published: 원문 일치. 'her first collection of poems was published' ←정답
❌ ③ influenced: influenced(영향을 미친)는 후반부 맥락
❌ ④ received: received(받은)는 별명 맥락
det.tip: her first collection was published — 시집이 출판(published)되었다

questions.passage: Born in 1888 in Bombay (now Mumbai), India, Sarojini Naidu was a talented poet and political leader. She received the nickname "The Nightingale of India" because of the beauty of her poetry. She began writing poetry at age 12 and was soon recognized for her literary talent. In 1905, her first collection of poems was published. Later she joined India's struggle for freedom from British rule. As a powerful speaker, she traveled widely and influenced many people. She became the first woman to serve as the president of the Indian National Congress in 1925. After India's independence, she served as the governor of the Uttar Pradesh province until her death in 1949.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 나이두의 출생, 시인 활동, 독립 운동 참여, 공직 역임까지 생애 전반을 다룸
det.analysis:
❌ ① 독립 운동 전개 — 나이두 개인 중심이지 독립운동 전체가 아님
✅ ② 나이두의 생애와 업적 — 출생부터 사망까지 시인+정치인 생애 전반 ←정답
❌ ③ 여성 참정권 — 최초 여성 의장 언급은 있지만 참정권 역사 전반이 아님
❌ ④ 식민지 시대 문학 — 시인 활동은 일부이지 인도 문학 전반이 아님
det.tip: 한 인물의 탄생~사망, 시인+정치인 역할 = 인물의 생애와 업적

questions.passage: Born in 1888 in Bombay (now Mumbai), India, Sarojini Naidu was a talented poet and political leader. She received the nickname "The Nightingale of India" because of the beauty of her poetry. She began writing poetry at age 12 and was soon recognized for her literary talent. In 1905, her first collection of poems was published. Later she joined India's struggle for freedom from British rule. As a powerful speaker, she traveled widely and influenced many people. She became the first woman to serve as the president of the Indian National Congress in 1925. After India's independence, she served as the governor of the Uttar Pradesh province until her death in 1949.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 시인으로서 문학적 성취 + 독립 투쟁·국민회의 의장·주지사 등 정치적 기여
det.analysis:
✅ ① 문학+정치 양쪽 기여 — 시인(나이팅게일 별명) + 독립 투쟁 참여 + 의장 + 주지사 ←정답
❌ ② 여성 정치인 전체 — 나이두 한 사람에 집중, 여성 정치인 전체가 아님
❌ ③ 시를 통한 사회 변혁 — 나이두는 시인이자 정치인이지 시로 변혁한 것이 아님
❌ ④ 비폭력 저항 — 비폭력에 대한 언급 없음
det.tip: 시인(Nightingale of India) + 정치인(president, governor)

ch: 나이두는 문학과 정치 양쪽에서 인도에 크게 기여한 인물이다.
인도의 독립은 여성 정치인들의 희생 덕분에 이루어졌다.
시를 통한 사회 변혁이 정치적 행동보다 효과적이다.
영국 식민 통치에 대한 저항은 비폭력적이어야 한다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 불일치 — 'until her death in 1949' → 1949년에 사망했으므로 이후 수행 불가
det.analysis:
❌ ① 일치 — 'Bombay (now Mumbai)'
❌ ② 일치 — 1905년 출판 = 20세기 초
✅ ③ 불일치 — 1949년에 사망(until her death in 1949). 이후 수행 불가 ←정답
❌ ④ 일치 — 'the president of the Indian National Congress in 1925'
det.tip: until her death in 1949 = 1949년 사망까지 재직. 이후는 없음

ch: 나이두가 태어난 봄베이는 현재 뭄바이로 불린다.
